question: Rajinder Khanna, Deputy NSA and former chief of India's external intelligence agency Research and Analysis Wing (R&AW), was promoted to the position of _____________ in July 2024.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Additional NSA**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Rajinder Khanna, a former chief of India's external intelligence agency Research and Analysis Wing (R&AW), was promoted to the position of **Additional NSA** in July 2024.
 
• He previously served as the Deputy National Security Advisor (NSA) of India, contributing significantly to national security and intelligence strategies.
 
• The position of Additional NSA is vital for assisting the NSA in managing complex national security matters, including both internal and external threats.
